scope: For every beta>0 and p>0, no universal bound exists for integral (1+|t|)^beta |phi_Q(t)|^p dt over the full QFORM input class; failure already occurs for A=I_3 and iid finite-fragment cap-one densities supported in the fixed interval [1,10].
summary: Phase-aligned finite-fragment marginals can be chosen so |phi_Q(s)|>=1/8 at arbitrarily large s. Because Q is supported in [0,300], |phi_Q'|<=300, so the bump persists on a fixed-width interval. Every positive polynomially weighted L^p Fourier integral therefore becomes arbitrarily large. This refutes a uniform weighted-moment route to continuity, not the unweighted L1 route, bounded-density conjecture, or continuity itself.
